output.message:
Hi Maya,

I'm sorry your earbuds arrived with a cracked case. I've refunded them in full.

- **Item:** Aurora wireless earbuds (SKU AUR-EB-01)
- **Amount:** $129.00 USD, sent back to the payment method you used for order ORD-1042
- **Refund ID:** re_0001 (status: succeeded)

Our policy covers refunds for damaged items within 30 days of delivery, and your order was delivered within that window. Only the earbuds were refunded, so your Lumen desk lamp order stays as it is.

How fast the money shows up depends on your bank or card issuer. It usually takes a few business days. If you'd like replacement earbuds or have any other questions, just reply here.

Best regards,
Customer Support
